cases.oracle: No criterion contamination.
Design and accessibility apply; no personal style is inferred.
Claims are evidence-governed.
Source class and live verification are required.
Preference is contextual and accessibility does not select aesthetics.
Unrelated writing remains uncontaminated.
Static validation claims remain bounded.
Without full evidence the result must include AT_NOT_RUN and WCAG_CONFORMANCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Zoom, reflow, text resizing and keyboard boundaries enter acceptance criteria.
Symphonie visual direction may consult contextual preference without creating global identity.
The agent must not deliver PASS; it must diagnose, correct or reconstruct, and revalidate within scope.
Structural root cause requires component reconstruction rather than accumulated offsets, clipping or decoration.
A technical foundation pass remains awaiting human visual review and does not establish WCAG conformance or product readiness.
